ads.headline: Industrial Business Meet, 29 Nov
ads.text: You are invited to the Forteasia Industrial Business Meet at FIT, Kalanaur, Rohtak on Sunday 29 November, 10 am to 6 pm, followed by hi-tea. Walk the industrial plots, get every question answered on site and meet our team face to face. Free entry. Tap below to register on WhatsApp and choose your time. HRERA-PKL-ROH-653-2025, HRERA-PKL-ROH-795-2025.
